allocation_reproduction.not_reproduced: the deleted candidate-scoring stage that ranked the nine candidates by D_func on teacher-state contexts

static_a8_range_table.role: historical static-activation path; the deployed DyRange-A8 rule recomputes ranges per forward and does not read this table

buffer.data_source: synthetic and data-free: random images and states drawn from the checkpoint's recorded ranges, in RoboCasa365 observation format
buffer.digest_covers: generation parameters (format, observation count, horizon, action dimension) and the observation and noise tensors

claim: The archived RIPA score bank, the static A8 range table, and the 100-W4/16-FP16 final mask share one deterministic calibration buffer whose digest is re-derived exactly, and the archived allocation entry point reproduces the parent plan and its nine candidates from that bank.

metadata_discrepancy.note: Observation format and data source are separate properties. The recorded buffer is synthetic and data-free in both cases, so only the format label differs: obs_source names the L1 format, while the digest fixes RoboCasa365 format.

reference_protocol.recorded_global_dsolver_pairing: pure FP16 model vs full config
reference_protocol.recorded_guard_reference: pure FP16 model (deployment pairing); D_sat proxied by P99.9(|fp_out|)/127
reference_protocol.recorded_value: wrapped pipeline, all target layers weight_bits=0, A8 static act, rotations active

scope: The audit establishes consistency among surviving artifact records and reproduces the allocation stage. The scoring stage that ranked the nine candidates is no longer in the tree and was not re-run, so the audit does not establish end-to-end regeneration of the historical mask.
